plan.title: Single-stage delivery date before bidding end

steps.note: Open the Events list as required before creating the event.
Verify the events list and Create Event control are available.
Choose the Single Stage creation path.
Set the single-stage event type to RFQ.
Provide the mandatory event title so publish reaches the date validation.
Apply the first RFQ template offered so the product sheet is available.
Add the CYLINDER product and set Quantity Requested to 10.
Populate required sheet fields so the event can proceed to scheduling and publishing.
Verify the RFQ product sheet rendered the columns used by the case.

args.goal: On the single-stage RFQ create screen, set Delivery location to Plant Name (LOC-0001), set the delivery date to today, and configure the bidding end for tomorrow; stop with both dates visibly shown.

steps.note: Configure the named delivery location and the required delivery-date/bidding-end relationship that no dedicated catalog step can set.
Add one QA vendor so the publish attempt is not blocked by the unrelated participant prerequisite.
Attempt to publish the event with delivery earlier than the bidding end.
Capture any refusal, warning, or other publish outcome shown after the date-conflict attempt.
